newsitem.title: USA: Resource Mortgage unit files for bond offer.
newsitem.headline: Resource Mortgage unit files for bond offer.

text.p: MERIT Securities Corp, a unit of Resource Mortgage Capital Inc said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $2 billion in collateralized mortgage bonds.
The Glen Allen, Va.,-based company said when combined with previous registrations, MERIT will have up to $2,161,482,410 in mortgage backed bonds, the filing said.
Net proceeds will be used to purchase related mortgage collateral and to repay debt, if any, that has been incurred to obtain funds to acquire such mortgage collateral, the filing said.
Proceeds will also be used to establish any reserve fund and to pay costs of structuring and issuing such bonds.
